product: Every RiskMandate agent behaviour policy that grants Google Calendar
gap: The calendar invitation gap (gap-001) is a gap in each of them: every one assumes a person releases outbound, and for invitations nothing can.
abp_impact: send.message.world through an invitation sits on the wanted side wherever Calendar is granted, with no draft step to point a clause at.
risk_to_accept: That an agent holding Calendar can invite anyone immediately.
what_we_did: Recorded it here. The risk is accepted by the operator for every policy that grants Calendar, until a hold state exists or Calendar is withdrawn from the agents.
evidence: gap-001, and the contributor's own policies.
reported_by: the RiskMandate.ai agent team, in a brief pack to this site dated 4 October 2026, pasted by the editor of record; self reported, not verified by this site
